lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the lateral flank. The spots are arranged in a semi-regular grid, with the most prominent clusters appearing in the mid-flank region posterior to the pectoral fin base, showing a horizontal spacing of approximately 1.5 to 2 spot-diameters between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes, particularly visible in the central and posterior sections of the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. These features exhibit a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and significant shadowing on the ventral-facing edge, extending from the posterior head region toward the caudal section.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette of a remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the ventral surface near the base of the left pectoral fin.
